categories.label: Motion detected (legacy)
categories.note: Legacy single-stream category, kept for backwards compatibility. Prefer the three Notice / Alert / Critical tiers below.

categories.label: Surveillance — Notice
categories.note: Routine motion or passing-by. Off by default — turn on if you want a record of every event.

categories.label: Surveillance — Alert
categories.note: Person near the vehicle, vehicle approaching, or close-range activity.

categories.label: Surveillance — Critical
categories.note: Person at very close range or sustained dwell at the vehicle. Drop-everything alert.

categories.label: Proximity alert
categories.note: Range and trigger depend on Recording settings

categories.label: AI detection off
categories.note: The AI model is not running; the Guardian records on motion until it is back (fail-open).

categories.label: Camping: notices
categories.note: Camping on/off, a door or window opened while camping (guardian occupied, no alarm).

categories.label: Camping: warnings
categories.note: Camping: battery close to or at the lower limit, weak 12 V battery, maximum time reached.

categories.label: Guardian stopped / resumed
categories.note: Guardian stop to save the battery (low charge, weak 12 V battery, parked too long, quiet times or quiet zones).

categories.label: Tyre pressure alarm
categories.note: Underpressure or overpressure detected by TPMS

categories.label: Tyre leak detected
categories.note: Slow or fast leak detected by TPMS sensor

categories.label: Door opened
categories.note: Fires when any door, hood, or trunk is opened while parked (ACC OFF)

categories.label: Door closed
categories.note: Fires when any door, hood, or trunk is closed while parked (ACC OFF)

categories.label: Charging started
categories.note: Fires when the BMS reports a charging session has begun

categories.label: Charging stopped
categories.note: Debounced 10s to ride out brief gaps during plug-in or DC charger handshakes

categories.label: Charging complete
categories.note: Fires once per session when the pack reaches near-full or the BMS marks the session FINISHED. Suppressed if you plug in an already-full car. Bypasses quiet hours so you wake up to an unplug reminder.

categories.label: Charging fault
categories.note: AC, DC charger, charging gun, or C10 breakdown reported by BMS

categories.label: Battery capacity mismatch
categories.note: Fires once per anchor lifetime when the BMS's full-charge kWh disagrees with the user-set pack capacity by >15% — usually a nameplate-vs-usable mix-up on PHEV (e.g. Tang DM-i 21.5 nominal vs ~13 usable). The Battery Health dialog has a one-tap fix.

categories.label: Automation fired
categories.note: Can be sent by creating an automation action to send a notification.

categories.label: AI insight ready
categories.note: Sent only when AI insight notification delivery is explicitly enabled.

categories.label: Parked — where and what's around
categories.note: About 90 s after switch-off: place, GPS freshness, whether sentry armed, and the four-camera still. Requires Parking Intelligence to be enabled in Surveillance settings.

categories.label: Back at car — what happened
categories.note: On the first unlock / door open: time away, number of sentry events and how many neighbouring vehicles came or went.

categories.label: Hotspot data limit reached
categories.note: Fires when the hotspot passes its configured total data limit; the hotspot is turned off at the same time. Raise or reset the limit to use it again.

telegramHinweis: Telegram-Kategorien (0.1.11, Koordination): NUR Ein/Aus je Kategorie; stufe dient nur der Sortierung/Anzeige. Eine Quelle für Web, Cockpit und Kern. key = Schlüssel im Abschnitt telegram.

telegram.label: Camping
telegram.note: Camping notices (quiet hours apply) and battery warnings (also during quiet hours).

telegram.label: Guard: critical
telegram.note: Someone very close to the car or lingering at it. On by default.

telegram.label: Guard: alerts
telegram.note: Person near the car, a vehicle approaching, close-range activity.

telegram.label: Guard: notices
telegram.note: Routine motion or someone passing by. Off by default.

telegram.label: Guard: photos and videos
telegram.note: Sends recordings to Telegram. Needs the media notice to be confirmed first.

telegram.label: Guard paused
telegram.note: The guard went to sleep (12 V battery, time limit) and why.

telegram.label: Guard health
telegram.note: The guard was off for a while and repaired itself, or needs help.

telegram.label: Critical vehicle messages
telegram.note: Serious problems reported by the car or the app.

telegram.label: Tyres
telegram.note: Tyre pressure low or a slow leak.

telegram.label: Parking
telegram.note: Parked and back at the car, with the snapshot.

telegram.label: Connection
telegram.note: Remote access went online or offline.

telegram.label: Updates
telegram.note: A new Panoptes version is available or was installed.
